system.description: This flat, crystalline rectangle is normally clear but becomes cloudy when attuned to a spell. By attuning this stone to a specific sorcery spell, the bearer can reduce that spell's mote cost by (her own Essence x 2). However, this stone cannot reduce a spell's cost by more than half. Also, no combination of this stone with similar effects (such as the No Moon Caste ability) can reduce a spell's cost below 1 mote. While the user can possess more than one of these stones, only one can be attuned to a particular spell. Attuning this stone requires the bearer to meditate quietly with the stone for a number of hours equal to the normal Essence cost of this spell.
